project_scope.selection_mode: B039 canonical anchors + B152 strict-review handoff
project_scope.note: M. citriodora and M. punctata are installed PASS anchors. M. fistulosa remains a true open review task and is not installed until independent taxonomy/range review is complete.

priority: stacked separated whorls versus more conventional dense terminal heads
length of bristle tips on bracts and calyx teeth
whole-plant life history and habitat only after floral morphology
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify Monarda by flower color alone. For the installed anchors, long bristle-tipped bracts/calyx teeth point to M. citriodora; pale bracts plus cream/yellow heavily purple-spotted flowers and an open ciliate calyx mouth point to M. punctata. M. fistulosa is pending strict review and should not be treated as a local PASS yet.

quick_key.if: tiered/interrupted flower whorls with purplish bracts narrowed into long bristle tips and long bristle-tipped calyx teeth
tiered whorls with pale white/pink bracts, cream-to-yellow purple-spotted corollas, and short triangular calyx teeth
source says wild bergamot / Monarda fistulosa
quick_key.then: pending strict review; do not install or count as target-zone PASS until taxonomy/range review is complete
